machine: Fedora 45, GNOME 51.1 Wayland, AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, every process pinned to CPU 2 with taskset (startup: CPUs 2-7)
method: interleaved rounds, the order reversed every other round; each value is one suite run median (pipeline_corpus_mib_s: one throughput per run)

callgrind_instructions.note: one Callgrind count per case; the old pin carries the counting harness of 9c9f47c9 applied to a copy, and the terminal echo and pipeline cases are wrapped in the same counter in a copy of each side (the head copy without its paths_* cases)
